caption: The drawing consists of fifteen rectangular and square swatches of patterned fabric, arranged in three columns against a plain beige background. The leftmost and largest column contains five larger fabric swatches. The top swatch is brown with a blue and red floral motif and a small blue dot. Below it, a swatch displays a geometric zigzag pattern in red, purple, white, and blue. The next one is light beige with a dense, delicate leaf background and blue-and-red flowers. Below, an irregular rectangle is divided diagonally: one half is dark brown with pale leaf shapes, and the other half is light with sparse floral motifs. The bottom swatch in this column is brown with red and blue flowers. The center column comprises three rectangles: the top one matches the diagonally divided swatch from the left column, the middle features diagonal maroon bands with white and brown zigzag motifs, and the bottom is dark with a grid of small, multicolored fish shapes and a large white blossom. The rightmost column displays seven smaller rectangles or squares, each with a different geometric or abstract motif. These include, from top to bottom, patterns with white ovals and dots on brown, yellow and purple interlocking rings, a swirling white sunburst on brown, pale stripes with dark accents, repeated stylized leaf shapes in blue and red with black outlines, a brown diamond pattern with red and white ovals, and a horizontal stripe with red and blue ovals. The swatches collectively exhibit a range of patterns including florals, geometric motifs, and abstract shapes, using a palette dominated by brown, beige, red, blue, white, and purple tones.
title: Textile from Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
